description: Procurement for the supply of 54,000 liposomal form of Amphotericin B 50mg Vials
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-11-02 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Bids have been invited following the international competitive procurement method for the supply of 54,000 liposomal form of Amphotericin B 50mg Vials, which is used to treat life-threatening fungal infections, including Cryptococcal meningitis and Visceral leishmaniasis. Three (03) bids have been received for the same. The proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to award the said procurement to Gufic Biosciences Ltd. of India, (Manufacturer: Gufic Biosciences Ltd., India), substantially responsive lowest evaluated bidder, at a total Cost and Freight (Air) price of USD 702,000 based on the recommendation submitted by the Standing High Level Procurement Committee after evaluating the said bids, was approved by the Cabinet.
